description: The live view check of every host. The engine (com.blockether.vis.contract.view/live-view-faults) and the Python SDK (blockether.vis._contracts.live_view_faults) must give the same answer for each declared view here. class ok accepts the view; class view refuses the whole view with the lines in text; class node shows each node of cards as an error card with the fault text of the same position in text. dropped holds one note for each shortcut that names a broken node. JSON has no NaN: nan_at is the path where a test puts NaN before it checks the view. patches holds raw patches: com.blockether.vis.contract.view/live-patch-lines and blockether.vis._contracts.live_patch_lines must give the lines in expect before a host applies an op. applies holds a declared view and patch ops that every host applies (the engine materializer and vis.testing.LiveRecorder): expect holds the refusal text, or the value at a path of the patched wire view. owner, when given, names the extension that owns the view; without it the owner is the agent.
